source.notes: SATB on two staves (upper = S+A, lower = T+B). MUELLER is a 3/4 tune with a one-beat pickup; this edition is engraved in 4/4 without a pickup, so the manifest overrides the meter (timeSig 3/4) and declares the pickup. Notes and durations are unchanged. Source MIDI tempo is 60 qpm; overridden to 100 qpm for play.
